record.field: Rules for SMS steps in a marketing campaign: the sms activity type, its mailing, and the sms trigger types. Load before adding or editing any SMS step, or any step reacting to one.

Extends section 3, ACTIVITY, and section 4, MAILING.
`activity_type = 'sms'`, with `mass_mailing_id` on a mailing whose `mailing_type = 'sms'`. Never use an email activity to stand in for one.
The text goes in `body_plaintext`, not `body_arch`. `subject` is only an internal title. `email_from` is not required.
Recipients need a mobile number on the campaign's model. Check before planning an SMS step.
The only SMS trigger types are `sms_click`, `sms_not_click` and `sms_bounce` - there is no open- or reply-based SMS trigger, whatever names appear elsewhere.
Add SMS only when asked: it costs credits per message.
